biggest_catch: Your rate depends on your loyalty tier and the item's category — a fine watch can pay you 85% while a low-value apparel item pays far less.
catches: Tiered by RealReal Rewards: commission rate based on net sales in your one-year commission window; per the official SEC S-1, rates range 55% (under $1,500 net sales) to 70% ($10,000+ net sales).
Item commission rates (per RealReal's own promotional terms): fine watches $2,500+ earn 85%; handbags $5,000+ earn 80%; handbags $1,000–$4,999 and fine jewelry $1,000+ earn 70%.
Item-level rates go as low as 40% for items with an original resale list price of $145 or less (per official SEC S-1).
Get Paid Now = upfront payment but lower than consignment; site credit pays +5% extra.
The RealReal takes physical possession, authenticates, photographs, and lists for you — zero seller effort, but you cede all pricing control.
Rates can change at any time at their discretion (promotional terms say so explicitly).

Official RealReal promotional email (archived on milled.com): 'Earn 85% of the selling price when you consign a fine watch with a list price of $2,500 or more. Earn 80% of the selling price when you consign a handbag with a list price of $5,000 or more. maximize: Route high-value pieces here: fine watches and handbags earn 70–85% — the best rate of any full-service consignment platform. Build your loyalty tier early in your commission window; your starting rate next window equals your highest rate this window, so volume compounds. Take Consign (not Get Paid Now) when you can wait — it's the highest rate. Take site credit (+5%) if you're buying luxury anyway. Check The RealReal's current promo page before consigning — first-time consignor credits stack on top of commission. Low-value apparel pays poorly here; those pieces go to Poshmark or Depop where you keep more.

who_pays: The RealReal pays you — consignment earnings after your item sells, Get Paid Now upfront payment, or site credit (which pays +5% extra).

work_available: The RealReal's consignment program is active — they take physical possession, authenticate, photograph, and list for you.
what_gets_accepted: Items must be authentic luxury goods; The RealReal authenticates, photographs, and lists for you — zero seller effort, but you cede all pricing control. Commission tiers: you keep 55% of the sale price under $1,500 in one-year net sales up to 70% at $10,000+; item-level rates include 85% on fine watches $2,500+, 80% on handbags $5,000+, 70% on handbags $1,000–$4,999 and fine jewelry $1,000+, and as low as 40% on items with a resale list price of $145 or less. costs_and_unpaid_time: No listing fees — the commission is the cost: The RealReal keeps 30–45% of the sale price depending on your tier (you keep the rest). Get Paid Now takes an additional discount for upfront cash. Unpaid time is minimal: shipping your item to them; they do everything else.
when_cash_arrives: After your item sells plus the buyer's return window passes — via check, direct deposit, or site credit (+5% extra).
